name: Mitamamon
main_effect:
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] By trashing the top card of your security stack, you may play 1 yellow level 4 or lower card from your hand without paying the cost. Digimon played by this effect gain ＜Rush＞ for the turn. (This Digimon can attack the turn it comes into play.)
[All Turns] All of your yellow Digimon gain ＜Barrier＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted in battle, by trashing the top card of your security stack, prevent that deletion.).
[Opponent's Turn] All of your opponent's Digimon with levels greater than or equal to the total cards in both players' security stacks gain ＜Security A. -2＞ (This Digimon checks 2 additional security cards.).
